summary.text: Adelita Grijalva is the Democratic incumbent U.S. Representative for Arizona's 7th Congressional District. A Tucson native, she worked for more than 25 years at Pima County Teen Court, served on the Tucson Unified School District Governing Board from 2002 and on the Pima County Board of Supervisors from 2020, and won the seat in a September 2025 special election after the death of her father, Rep. Raúl Grijalva. She is seeking a full term in 2026.

paragraphs.text: Grew up on the south side of Tucson with her two sisters and graduated from Pueblo High School, according to her official House biography; Wikipedia gives the year as 1989.
Earned a degree in political science from the University of Arizona (a B.A. in 1995, per Wikipedia).
Worked at Pima County Teen Court for more than 25 years, serving as its director; the program is a restorative juvenile diversion program for court-involved youth.

First elected to public office in 2002 to the Tucson Unified School District Governing Board, where she served about 18 years; she was the only board member to vote against ending the district's Mexican American Studies classes in 2012, according to Wikipedia.

Elected to the Pima County Board of Supervisors in 2020 and became the first Latina and second woman to chair the board, according to her official bio, which lists a county preschool program, affordable-housing investments and open-space protection among her accomplishments.
Daughter of the late U.S. Rep. Raúl Grijalva, whose Arizona's 7th District seat she won in the September 23, 2025 special election, defeating Republican Daniel Butierez Sr.
Sworn in on November 12, 2025, after a seven-week delay that followed the special election and coincided with a federal government shutdown, according to Wikipedia.
Serves on the House Committee on Education and Workforce and the Committee on Natural Resources and is a member of the Congressional Progressive Caucus and Congressional Hispanic Caucus.
Lives in Tucson with her husband Sol and has three children, according to her official bio.
